method: Manually read every full allocated root and connected actual paths. Serialize/hash only explicit reviewed spans and pinned Git blobs. Metadata script does not classify, scan, parse, run tests or source helpers.

classification_definitions.integration: Core observable materially uses real project API/network/OS/filesystem/store boundary, including direct production readback of asserted state.
classification_definitions.unit: Local predicates/projections/pre-I/O guards or synthetic clients/maps only; incidental setup files/servers confer no boundary credit.
classification_definitions.mixed: Distinct independent local-only assertion block plus real boundary assertions.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Mapping/source evidence inadequate or source-visible blocker prevents credit.

qualification_limits: Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION. No compilation, tests, project helpers, cryptographic operations or cloud/process/runtime execution performed.

The kvsnapshot fixture directly starts upstream nats-server and connects through loopback TCP using nats.Connect; it does not call project natscell.Start. One server and local temporary FileStorage do not prove replicated cell recovery or production deployment.

The concrete OCI SDK is wired to httptest HTTP and a disk-backed simulator. The simulator checks nonempty Authorization, checksums and conditional ETags, not real OCI identity/IAM/cloud durability. No production OCI calls performed or qualified.
Insight tests use fake providers and in-memory History; displayed filesystem paths and command strings are never executed. Local channel/timer behavior confers no network boundary credit.
The false-leader Run test never reaches SnapshotOnce; real fixtures created before its guard are incidental.
Assertions are retained as exact whole root interior spans including all branches and conditions; setup checks have no separate root credit.
All 20 baseline/current raw declarations match historical survival hashes. Every cited canonical source file and each baseline test file is pinned by Git blob/mode/SHA256/bytes.
No ledger, source, repository, runtime, deletion, retirement, qualification or global completion credit. Independent peer review required.
